verdict.rationale: Deepgram ships an official `dg` CLI with a built-in MCP server for AI coding tools, so the AI-native CLI capability exists first-party. Its documented scope is transcription, live streaming, speech synthesis, text analysis and account management, with no documented Voice Agent commands. missing for 10: documented CLI support for Voice Agent workflows (e.g., creating or managing agent configurations or running agent sessions), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.
The dg CLI includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs.
